mapper.sql: count(1) as holding_count, coalesce(sum(h.holding_shares), 0) as total_holding_shares, coalesce(sum(h.cost_amount), 0) as total_cost_amount, coalesce(sum(h.market_value), 0) as total_market_value, coalesce(sum(coalesce(h.today_estimated_value, h.market_value)), 0) as total_today_estimated_value, coalesce(sum(coalesce(h.today_profit, 0)), 0) as total_today_profit, coalesce(sum(coalesce(h.holding_profit, h.market_value - h.cost_amount)), 0) as total_holding_profit
mapper.select:
select s.dimension, s.dimension_id, s.dimension_name, s.holding_count, round(s.total_holding_shares, 4) as total_holding_shares, round(s.total_cost_amount, 4) as total_cost_amount, round(s.total_market_value, 4) as total_market_value, round(s.total_today_estimated_value, 4) as total_today_estimated_value, round(s.total_today_profit, 4) as total_today_profit, round(s.total_holding_profit, 4) as total_holding_profit, round(s.total_holding_profit, 4) as total_profit_loss_amount, case when s.total_cost_amount = 0 then 0 else round(s.total_holding_profit * 100 / s.total_cost_amount, 4) end as total_holding_profit_rate from ( select 'USER' as dimension, #{userId} as dimension_id, '当前账户' as dimension_name,
from biz_user_fund_holding h where ) s

select s.dimension, s.dimension_id, s.dimension_name, s.holding_count, round(s.total_holding_shares, 4) as total_holding_shares, round(s.total_cost_amount, 4) as total_cost_amount, round(s.total_market_value, 4) as total_market_value, round(s.total_today_estimated_value, 4) as total_today_estimated_value, round(s.total_today_profit, 4) as total_today_profit, round(s.total_holding_profit, 4) as total_holding_profit, round(s.total_holding_profit, 4) as total_profit_loss_amount, case when s.total_cost_amount = 0 then 0 else round(s.total_holding_profit * 100 / s.total_cost_amount, 4) end as total_holding_profit_rate from ( select 'PORTFOLIO' as dimension, h.portfolio_id as dimension_id, coalesce(p.portfolio_name, '未分配组合') as dimension_name,
from biz_user_fund_holding h left join biz_user_portfolio p on p.tenant_id = h.tenant_id and p.user_id = h.user_id and p.id = h.portfolio_id and p.del_flag = '0' where group by h.portfolio_id, p.portfolio_name ) s order by s.dimension_id is null, s.dimension_id

select s.dimension, s.dimension_id, s.dimension_name, s.holding_count, round(s.total_holding_shares, 4) as total_holding_shares, round(s.total_cost_amount, 4) as total_cost_amount, round(s.total_market_value, 4) as total_market_value, round(s.total_today_estimated_value, 4) as total_today_estimated_value, round(s.total_today_profit, 4) as total_today_profit, round(s.total_holding_profit, 4) as total_holding_profit, round(s.total_holding_profit, 4) as total_profit_loss_amount, case when s.total_cost_amount = 0 then 0 else round(s.total_holding_profit * 100 / s.total_cost_amount, 4) end as total_holding_profit_rate from ( select 'GROUP' as dimension, g.id as dimension_id, g.group_name as dimension_name,
from biz_user_fund_group_relation gr inner join biz_user_fund_group g on g.tenant_id = gr.tenant_id and g.user_id = gr.user_id and g.id = gr.group_id and g.del_flag = '0' and g.status = 1 inner join biz_user_fund_holding h on h.tenant_id = gr.tenant_id and h.user_id = gr.user_id and h.id = gr.holding_id where gr.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and gr.user_id = #{userId} and gr.del_flag = '0' and group by g.id, g.group_name ) s order by s.dimension_id
